about.title: About
body: This is not a review blog. There are no stars, no scores, no recommendations.

Each entry starts from a single quote or saying about a genre or a subject — war, language, guilt, money — and then takes one film apart against it. Does the film prove the saying, argue with it, or sit somewhere in the middle?
The point is the practice, not the verdict. Folders are sorted by director, because the same director testing the same idea twice is usually where it gets interesting.
about.note: A saying is a hypothesis. A film is the experiment.
